title: Faultline
pitch: Charged seismic stomps tear permanent branching cracks through the plateau, and those cracks slowly mineralise into ore veins you mine forever after.
howto: Hold STOMP to charge, drag to aim, release to split the rock — every fault is saved for good, walls off the tremorlings that hunt you, and ripens into copper, iron, gold and prism. Stand on a glowing vein to mine it, then spend the ore on longer, deeper, richer faults and break the rim into harder biomes.
controls: Drag anywhere to walk. Hold the STOMP pad to charge, drag off it to aim, release to slam; a quick tap makes a radial mini-fault. Stand near a ripe vein to auto-mine. Desktop: WASD/arrows to move, hold Space to charge and aim with the mouse.
